One-line description: Comprehensive auditing & hardening scanner for Linux/Unix systems
When to use: Every time you run the full audit (local dev machine, server, or CI baseline)
What it solves: Detects misconfigurations, missing patches, weak permissions, and CIS-benchmark violations

When to use: Optional deep scan (uncomment in script) or scheduled cron jobs on servers
What it solves: Finds viruses, trojans, ransomware, and known malware in files/directories (including node_modules or downloads)

One-line description: Rootkit Hunter – scans for known rootkits, backdoors & local exploits
What it solves: Detects hidden malware that replaces system binaries, hides processes, or installs backdoors

One-line description: Lightweight rootkit detector using known signature checks
When to use: Paired with rkhunter in every audit for cross-verification
What it solves: Quickly spots classic rootkit patterns and system file inconsistencies
